gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: As well as speaking fluent French, she also speaks Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition to = as well as.
